input.prompt: Candid 35mm film still, wide shot from across a long kitchen table, early morning in a small lived-in apartment kitchen before the lights are fully on. A woman in her late twenties with dark hair in a loose low bun and small gold earrings, wearing a cream and navy Breton-striped long-sleeve top, sits at the far side of the worn oak table typing on a silver laptop, a red ceramic mug of coffee steaming beside her. Cool blue-grey daylight from a window on the left, warm light from an under-cabinet strip and a small lamp on the counter behind her, deep soft shadows, most of the room falling into shadow. On the table in the foreground, out of focus: a plate with a half-eaten slice of toast, a folded newspaper, a phone charging cable, a set of keys. Behind her: open shelves with mismatched jars, a kettle, dishes drying in a rack, a plant on the windowsill. 28mm lens at seated eye level, shallow depth of field, slightly tilted handheld framing, natural skin texture, visible film grain, slightly soft focus, unretouched, realistic, not a stock photo, no text.
